problem_statement:
Plug.Router macros and functional plugs
I'm super new to elixir, so forgive me if the below doesn't make sense.

If I attempt to use a  functional plug with the router macros e.g. `match` I get the error `** (UndefinedFunctionError) function :foo.init/1 is undefined (module :foo is not available)`. I'm pretty sure the issue is not with my plug, as it works when using the regular plug macro e.g. ` plug :foo`.

Minimal reproduction below

```elixir
defmodule Router do
  use Plug.Router

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  @spec foo(Plug.Conn.t(), any()) :: Plug.Conn.t()
  def foo(conn, _opts) do
    conn
  end

  match _, to: :foo
end
```

If I'm not making any errors then please consider this a feature request - The functional plugs are much more simple/concise, so it would be great to be able to use them in more places, if not everywhere, just for the sake of consistency.
interface:
Method: Plug.Adapters.Test.Conn.conn(conn :: %Plug.Conn{}, method :: atom, uri :: binary, body_or_params :: term) 
Location: lib/plug/adapters/test/conn.ex 
Inputs: a Plug.Conn struct representing the parent connection, an HTTP method atom (e.g. :get), a request URI string, and a body or params (map, keyword list, or binary) to be sent with the request. 
Outputs: a new %Plug.Conn{} representing the simulated child request/response. 
Description: Builds a test connection based on the given parent %Plug.Conn{}, applying the method, URI, and request data, and returns the resulting connection for further assertions. 

Function: Plug.Conn.get_cookies(conn :: %Plug.Conn{}) :: map 
Location: lib/plug/conn.ex 
Inputs: a Plug.Conn struct whose cookies have been fetched (i.e., after calling `fetch_cookies/2`). 
Outputs: a map where each key is a cookie name (binary) and each value is the decoded cookie value (any). 
Description: Returns the combined request and response cookies for the connection; raises if cookies have not been fetched. 

Function: Plug.Conn.get_resp_cookies(conn :: %Plug.Conn{}) :: map 
Location: lib/plug/conn.ex 
Inputs: a %Plug.Conn{} struct (typically after a response has been sent or cookies set). 
Outputs: a map where each key is a cookie name (binary) and each value is a map of cookie metadata (e.g., value, path, secure). 
Description: Retrieves the response cookies that have been set on the connection, exposing the same data previously available via the deprecated `resp_cookies` field.
